title: Wiemer
description: Quiet product-launch light: a near-white page and a second pale grey for bands and cards, near-black ink, one loud brand orange for a whole spec band and small mono tags, and a sparing system blue for submit buttons. One neo-grotesk at weight 500, display sizes that follow the window width, a geometric mono for tags and prices. Small 6–14px radii, flat, hairlines.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with the same orange and blue
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Neue Montreal (closed); Space Mono for Supply Mono (closed)
--page-gutter and --section-y are fluid (clamp): 24px/48px on phones, 40px/112px at 1440
